Paired client: %1$s\n\nThis experimental R5 build permits read-only page text and fresh viewport screenshots of the visible Kelpie browser tab, only after your approval and while Kelpie remains on screen. It cannot click, type, navigate, publish, make payments, or access other apps or the lock screen. Page text and images may contain private information. You can stop immediately from the app or the Android notification. The grant is lost when the app process stops.
